architectural_notes: Prompts and categories must persist across refresh/reopen.
Category input supports selecting an existing category or typing a new one (auto-create if new).
After saving a prompt, the UI should remain on the current view; new category should appear under 'Favorites'.
Clicking a category should open the saved prompt(s) using the currently selected display format (as chosen next to 'Newest First').
known_issues: Bug: '+ Add Prompt' Save closes dialog but does not persist the new prompt/category; category does not appear under Favorites and prompt cannot be reopened via category click.

existing_features.title: Fix the '+ Add Prompt' Save flow so a newly created prompt is reliably persisted (backend + in-memory UI state) instead of the dialog closing with the prompt missing.

Ensure categories entered/selected in the prompt editor are persisted so that any new category created during '+ Add Prompt' appears under Favorites in the category filter bar immediately after saving the prompt and remains after refresh.
Make clicking a category in the CategoryFilterBar correctly filter and allow opening prompts within that category, using the currently selected view mode (list/grid/table) behavior.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix '+ Add Prompt' Save not persisting prompts/categories; ensure new category appears under Favorites and prompts open correctly per selected display format
